universities.summary: Presidency College is a government arts and science college at Chepauk, Chennai, affiliated to the University of Madras. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and research study across several disciplines. Its hearing-impaired B.Com. and B.C.A. routes have specific academic and category requirements, separate from general admissions.
universities.campusLifestyle: The Chepauk campus has academic departments, a library, sports, student associations and service activities including NSS, NCC and Youth Red Cross. Students follow the college’s attendance, examination and conduct rules. Shift and programme arrangements differ; verify the exact route before making daily travel or accommodation plans.
universities.cityProfile: Presidency College is at 100 Kamarajar Salai, Chepauk, Chennai 600005, Tamil Nadu. This is the government college on Chennai’s seafront, not Presidency College in Bengaluru or Presidency University in Kolkata. Check the Chennai address, college code 1011001 and official pcc.ac.in domain when comparing admissions.
universities.practicalExposure: The college lists subject departments, learning outcomes and placement/training support. Academic practical work, projects and subject facilities vary by degree. The hearing-impaired admission category and English-medium label do not establish a particular interpreter, signing or accessibility service; applicants should obtain individual confirmation.
universities.hostelOverview: The college lists Victoria Boys Hostel and a College Ladies Hostel as separate student services. A course offer does not establish room availability or allocation. Ask the relevant hostel office about application rules, access arrangements, full charges and meals before accepting accommodation.
universities.dietarySupport: Meal plans, food choices and personal dietary requirements are not verified for these specific admission routes. Ask the hostel or food provider about vegetarian/non-vegetarian choices, allergies, medical diets and included meals before budgeting or paying accommodation charges.
universities.safetyOverview: The college lists anti-ragging, student grievance, internal complaint and women-student grievance services. These provide institutional complaint and support channels. Applicants should obtain current contacts and discuss their own accessibility or emergency-support requirements with the college.
universities.studentSupport: The college lists a library, placement and training cell, soft-skills support, women’s grievance service and Arunodaya resource centre for visually challenged students. These are distinct services; the presence of one disability-support centre does not establish hearing-impairment-specific facilities. Discuss individual requirements directly.

faq.question: Who can use these two programme entries?

faq.question: What Class 12 subjects are required?
faq.answer: The Tamil Nadu disability department’s named Presidency College scheme requires Class 12 with Commerce for B.Com. and Class 12 with Computer Science for B.C.A. faq.question: What language and duration are recorded?

faq.question: What disability percentage is required?

faq.question: How should I apply?

faq.question: Is signing or interpreter support guaranteed?

The English-medium label and hearing-impaired admission category answer different questions. Discuss communication, classroom participation, assessment access and emergency arrangements directly with the college before enrolment.

faq.question: What does tuition cost?
faq.answer: A dated itemised annual tuition quote for these exact routes is not verified. The college’s fee table shows composite charges and a dash under tuition, which is not an explicit current zero-tuition guarantee. Ask for the applicable waiver and all compulsory academic, university, examination and living costs.

faq.question: Is overseas admission verified?

faq.question: Does admission include accommodation?
